definitions.explanation: The handheld part of a telephone containing the mouthpiece and earpiece, or a portable communication device held in the hand.

examples.japanese: ハンドセットを{取|と}る。
ハンドセットを{置|お}くと{通話|つうわ}が{切|き}れる。
examples.english: When you put down the handset, the call ends.

examples.japanese: この{電話機|でんわき}はハンドセットとコードが{分離|ぶんり}できる。
examples.english: On this telephone, the handset can be detached from the cord.

notes:
A loanword from English "handset," referring to the part of a telephone you hold to your ear and mouth. In technical and telecom contexts it can also refer to a mobile device as a whole.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハンドセットを{取|と}る: to pick up the handset
- ハンドセットを{置|お}く: to hang up the handset
- コードレスハンドセット: a cordless handset

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受話器|じゅわき}: telephone receiver — the common native term for the same part
- {子機|こき}: cordless handset (extension) — the portable unit of a cordless phone
